checkRuns.command:
grep -rl '\$lib/' src | xargs sed -i "s#\\\$lib/#\#lib/#"
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -8 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3

sed -i -E "s#'\#lib/(contact|server/books)'#'\#lib/\1.ts'#; s#'\#lib/favorites.svelte'#'\#lib/favorites.svelte.ts'#" $(grep -rl '#lib/' src --include=*.ts --include=*.svelte)
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -8 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3

docs.source: https://svelte.dev/llms.txt and the files it links
